svg.title: Errors list: 37 mistakes found so far in the project's own work, what caught each, and where each stands
svg.desc: A list of 37 errors: 33 in the research, 2 in reviews and 2 in process. 30 are corrected, 3 recorded and not undone, and 4 open.
svg.text: Errors list: 37 mistakes found so far in the project's own work, what caught each, and where
Grouped into research errors, errors in reviews of the work, and process errors. Each row names its date, its kind and what caught it.

especially since the government elected at the end of 2022.

Not recorded; issue 18 says commits are
Rule: an error is listed if it reached the repository's record (a commit, the change log or an issue), or was made in a review given to the author, and was
later found wrong, whether it has since been corrected, recorded without being undone, or is still open. Drafts corrected before they were committed are
not listed. No error recorded so far is a mistranslation; much of the work rests on Hebrew sources read by language-model readers, so that is not evidence
Where each was corrected: figures/data/fig7-errors.csv (from figures/sources/errors.csv), which cites the change-log item, commit or issue.
